messages.subject: Bioc-teaching call Oct 11, 2-3pm CEST
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone - quick reminder of the bioc-teaching call on Monday, October 11, at 2pm CEST. Please add any items you'd like to discuss to the agenda. As discussed last time, I made an attempt to create a list of the different types of educational material within the Bioconductor ecosystem (added to the agenda document) - feel free to add/modify!
Jitsi link as usual: https://meet.jit.si/BioconductorTeaching
See you on Monday!
Charlotte & Laurent
